title: Respiratory Therapy in COPD Exacerbations
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine effectiveness, feasibility and safety/tolerance of Respiratory Therapy in hospitalized patients with acute exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
raw_criteria:
Hospitalized patients with acute exacerbation of COPD.

Inclusion Criteria:

* age over 18 years,
* hospitalized patients and
* acute exacerbation of COPD.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous history of any chronic respiratory disease and
* not to have performed any kind of general or respiratory training in the previous 3 months.
condition: Obstructive Chronic Bronchitis With Acute Exacerbation
